pcs.pc_description: identify the work to be done and product specifications by interpreting the engineering drawing, Welding Procedure Specification (WPS) and job orders
identify welding requirements including relevant standards and codes from drawings, specifications and other customer and enterprise documentation

identify and arrange the AR system and simulator, tools, welding machines, measuring instruments, accessories, consumables and input materials (MS and SS plates) as per the requirements mentioned in WPS
check that material to be welded is as per the required specifications, quality and job requirement
diagnose and resolve any technical issues related to AR tools and systems, including software, hardware, and connectivity issues
ensure that the AR software and applications used for welding are up-to-date, including any necessary calibration or firmware updates
calibrate AR devices to maintain accuracy in the overlayed instructions and welding parameters
plan the welding activities before starting the actual process as per WPS
set welding parameters like current, voltage, electrode size, material thickness, and joint type in the AR simulator to match the real-world scenario
set up virtual welding scenarios related to vehicle parts welding such as indoor or outdoor welding, different positions (flat, horizontal, vertical), and the materials to be welded
follow appropriate safety practices as specified by organization during the work
prepare the workpiece and materials for welding by cleaning, grinding, and positioning them according to project specification and the chosen welding scenario
install the work pieces and fixture on the apparatus and align them with the electrodes as per the job requirements
adjust the settings of the welding machine (e.g., amperage, voltage) to match the simulation
ensure that electrodes distance, contact area, pressure, application etc. are maintained as specified in Work Instructions (WI)
use AR headsets and software to access welding instructions, visualize weld paths, and check for potential defects in real-time during the welding process
perform SMAW tasks while utilizing the AR guidance for precision and quality control
use AR overlays to accurately position welds, identify critical areas, and ensure proper joint alignment
confirm weld to be performed as per the job plan and specifications
ensure correct angle of torch and filler wire, direction of weld and feed and travel speed during the welding operation

monitor the welding process parameters (air pressure, electrode force, electrode distance, gas flow etc. are within standards by reading the feedbacks or warning indicators on the AR system (if displayed)
follow AR system suggestions (if any) for corrections in case of arc is too long or too short, user is moving too fast or slow etc. to maintain an optimal arc length
produce joints of the specified dimensional accuracy and required weld quality
measure the final welded piece and compare with the dimensions as prescribed in the WPS and engineering drawing
remove extra material, distortion etc. by using chipping hammers, grinders etc., from the welded piece
use AR systems to visually inspect welds, ensuring they meet specified standards and regulations
inspect welds using AR simulation to identify defects like porosity, undercuts, improper penetration etc.
conduct destructive and non-destructive tests on the work pieces
separate the defective pieces which can be repaired/ reworked and pieces which are beyond repair and maintain records of each category
tag and store the right quality pieces by following organisational policies and procedures
clean and store all the tools, machine and equipment after completion of work
remove chips from different machine areas and dispose scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
maintain detailed records of weld quality and any issues that are identified, including photographs or videos captured via AR devices for quality audits
report to the supervisor about any problems faced or anticipated during the complete process
